data.one_liner: A Flutter PDF viewer with a collapsible thumbnail sidebar and flow view.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive PDF viewer widget supporting both interactive zooming/panning and a static flow view. Includes features like a collapsible thumbnail sidebar, double-tap to zoom, page indicator, keyboard navigation, and accessibility support.
use_when: You need to display PDF documents from local assets or URLs inside your Flutter application.
You require a built-in thumbnail sidebar for easy multi-page navigation.
You need a PDF view that can flow naturally inside a parent CustomScrollView.
avoid_when: You need complex native PDF editing, annotation creation, or form-filling capabilities.
strengths: Collapsible thumbnail sidebar for fast navigation
Both interactive viewer (`PdfViewer`) and content-sized flow view (`PdfFlowView`) options
Full accessibility (VoiceOver/TalkBack) support and keyboard navigation
Optimized performance with lazy rendering and shared data
weaknesses: Text selection can crash on certain pages without valid text layers and is disabled by default
data.minimal_example:
PdfViewer(
  pdfPath: 'https://example.com/sample.pdf',
  initialPage: 3,
  initialSidebarOpen: true,
  onPageChanged: (page) => print('Now on page $page'),
)
